verificationContract: Actual engine capture is 1536x864 from scenes/cartoon.scene.json; use recorded QA fixture with fixed real GameState actor positions/action clocks and known world seed. Never use the concept PNG as a playable background substitute.
Match tier top anchors and all cap ends to the nominal/normalized measured targets within 4px; report every exception, occlusion or authored collision-grid approximation.
Keep full grey cap silhouettes when measuring ends; warm-only row sampling misses grey segments, and actor/bubble occlusion must not be reported as a new gap.

Save aligned 50% overlay, absolute difference and same-size crops for header, each tier, background focal area and footer. Difference pixels show remaining differences; preserved character drawings intentionally cannot be pixel-identical to the illustrated actors.

Separately prove real controls, routes, captures, rescue, wave/boss/restart; all four desktop aspects and required narrow/notched/tablet devices; full enlarged actor/crown-jump/HELP clearance; native text/diamonds and 14-draw budget.
Protect original 280 per-step traces and 48-pixel cases; previous recordings/evidence remain immutable. Record current checkpoints under new reconstruction names.
